value.title: Puniru Returns
value.synopsis: After Puniru goes missing in the middle of training to become cuter, Kotaro receives an unexpected package.

value.title: Going on a Journey with My Childhood Friend Slime in Another World. And Valentine's, Too!
value.synopsis: Kotaro is hit by a truck and finds himself in a world of swords and sorcery. Puniru learns about Valentine's.

value.title: RUNE RUNE DANCE
value.synopsis: When Runru breaks down one day, Puniru and Kotaro must find a way to have her repaired, but at what cost?

value.title: A Being More Perfect than a Toy
value.synopsis: After a science lab mishap, Dr. Mado unveils his latest creation: a super-intelligent robot made of slime!

value.title: Puniru Powers Up?! See It for Yourself!
value.synopsis: Kotaro has big plans for the summer, but could he be his own worst enemy? Meanwhile, Puniru seeks to power up.

value.title: A Human Happy Ending
value.synopsis: Gelee becomes the center of attention among the school's boys, including Kotaro, much to Puniru's chagrin.

value.title: A Midsummer's Runrune Resort
value.synopsis: Alice invites Kotaro to stay at Runrune Resort, but all Kotaro can think about is Gelee and her advances.

value.title: Trick or Kawaii!
value.synopsis: Gelee joins Kotaro's class as a student, to her chagrin. Meanwhile, Puniru plans a big surprise for Halloween.

value.title: Art is All About
value.synopsis: Hodai hatches a scheme to discredit Kotaro in Alice's eyes by having him face Nanpa in an artistic face-off.

value.title: Friendly Enough to Always Argue
value.synopsis: Kotaro gets into a big fight with Puniru, who runs away to Mami's apartment and meets the Kirara family.

value.title: The Human Condition
value.synopsis: Kotaro holds a study group with friends, but his careless remark to Gelee ends up having dire consequences.

value.title: That's What the World Calls Love
value.synopsis: Puniru turns into a perfect human girl, but Kotaro doesn't seem as happy to hear the news as everyone else.
